Name: Stillbloom - A Visual Editor
Author: BambooKatt
Description:
[size=3][font=Arial]Stillbloom is a visual editor that lets you enter an editor mode to move, organize and rearrange your farm without breaking anything, waiting seasons or depending on Robin's schedule.[/font][/size]
[size=3][font=Arial]Press a key and the farm freezes: grab what you want and put it wherever you like. Then save. Done. That's all![/font][/size]

[color=#a4c2f4][size=4]✨ What you can do[/size][/color]
[list]
[*][b]Move (almost) everything[/b] — crops, trees, bushes, furniture, objects, buildings.[/*]
[*][b]Ghost preview [/b]— see exactly where each thing will land before placing it, with a full-size translucent preview.[/*]
[*][b]Multi-select [/b]— hold Shift, select half your garden and move it all together as one block.[/*]
[*][b]Mess up in peace[/b] — Undo and Redo during the session. Changed your mind? One key and you're back.[/*]
[*][b]Full do-over[/b] — Reset brings everything back to where it was when you opened the editor.[/*]
[*][b]Time stands still [/b]— the day doesn't advance while you work. Take your time.[/*]
[/list]
[color=#a4c2f4][size=4]⚙️ Your way[/size][/color]
Everything goes through Generic Mod Config Menu: rebind every key, adjust camera speed, toolbar size, and choose how dangerously you want to live with placement rules (from Strict to full Anarchy).

Available in English and Italian.

Installation instructions
- Download the zip file
- Extract in the mods folder
- done, enjoy!

[i]GMCM is not required, you can edit the config file for settings, but it's reccomended![/i]

[color=#a4c2f4][size=4]⚠️ An honest note[/size][/color]
Stillbloom moves actual objects in your save. It's built to be safe, but moving buildings or placing things in non-standard areas can corrupt your save — keep a backup. It's been tested with several modded farms and content mods, but full compatibility with every mod out there can't be guaranteed. If something looks off, let me know!
